5.1.4: Storage Search shows which chest has your items

**New: Storage Search**
- `.storage search iron ingot` searches remembered container contents and outlines matching containers in green.
  Search by item name or ID, including names with spaces. Open and close storage first so the client can remember it.
- Results show item counts, coordinates, distance and when the contents were last seen. These are saved snapshots,
  not live contents from unopened chests. Works in multiplayer without a server plugin.
- Highlights show up to 64 containers within 128 blocks in your current dimension. `.storage clear` hides them
  without deleting remembered contents.
- Existing `#chest` searches use the same memory and highlights. `#chest <N> highlight` selects one result.
  The old `goto` syntax now highlights too, without moving you.

**Fixed: container memory**
- Normal container screens now reach the recording hook correctly.
- Leaving a container open longer than eight seconds no longer prevents it from being remembered.
- Emptying a container removes its old remembered items. Double chests no longer create duplicate records when
  you open different halves.
- Recording requires an actual storage interaction and synced contents. Unrelated menus and personal ender
  storage aren't recorded as physical chests, and records stay separate between worlds and servers.

Fabric, NeoForge and Forge on Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3; Fabric on Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1 (26.1.2).
